attacks.claim: The log line carries a 10-hex-char SHA-256 fingerprint of the API key. It is not the key and is not practically reversible, but the tenant id is already logged, so the fingerprint adds little and brushes against the 'keys never in logs' rule.
The upstream-429 retry sleep ignores req.signal. If the client disconnects mid-wait, the handler still sleeps up to 5s and then issues a second upstream call. The retry path is also untested.
attacks.evidence: await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay)); res = await upstream.chat(req.body, { signal: req.signal });
